question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Meta)

calls.reasoning: Q3 2026 guidance $61-64B (FX ~1% headwind); consensus ~$63.3B (+23.5% YoY vs $51.24B). Meta has landed at or above the top of its guide in nearly every recent quarter (Q2'26 60.8 vs ~61 top; Q1'26 56.3 vs 56.5; Q4'25 59.9 vs 59; Q3'25 51.2 vs 50.5; Q2'25 47.5 vs 45.5), so median ~ top of range, ~1-1.5% above consensus. Q2'26 growth 28% with impressions +14%, price +12% supports momentum. Downside risks: macro/AI-capex sentiment, FX. No human prediction market on the revenue figure found (Polymarket/Manifold none; Kalshi has a Meta earnings page but not a revenue-level contract that I verified). Escape outside 61-67B judged ~1% each, not declared.
